notes: The only collision of the race: Bearman (87) and Sainz (55) at Turn 5 (Variante della Roggia), lap 41. No car retired from a crash; there was no safety car, VSC or red flag. Contact time and the stop window come from both cars' recorded speed (data/monza-2025-sainz-telemetry.csv, data/monza-2025-bearman-telemetry.csv): Sainz fell from 85 to 23 km/h between 3339.698 and 3340.298 s and reached 0 km/h at 3344.298 s; Bearman was stationary from 3341.497 to 3343.618 s. Recorded positions are snapped to the track line by the timing feed, so the cars' heading during the spin is not recorded; the replay's spin is illustrative.
